TITLES.TYPE: What would you like to do?

ONBOARDING.CREATE_HELP: Choose a WhatsApp connection and agents one step at a time.
ONBOARDING.NO_INBOXES: No existing inbox is available to link in this account.
ONBOARDING.KEEP_AGENTS: Existing agents, conversations and settings will be kept. You can manage the inbox after linking it.
ONBOARDING.REVIEW_HELP: Check the details below. Setup starts only when you confirm. Pairing requires a separate explicit action.

DETAILS.HEALTH_HELP: Session, number approval, inbox link and message delivery are separate checks. These states do not confirm message synchronization or a new message being delivered.
DETAILS.CONFIGURATION_HELP: Actions below use this existing connection. Check its current state in Overview. No new inbox is created when reconnecting.
DETAILS.RECONNECTED_HELP: The number is approved and the inbox link is ready. Existing configuration has been kept. This does not confirm message delivery or synchronization; check delivery separately below.

DISTRIBUTION.ASSIGNED_ONLY: Agents see only their assigned conversations
DISTRIBUTION.EXCLUSIVE_HELP: Only supervisors and authorized administrators see the waiting queue. Availability, capacity and waiting are required in this mode.
DISTRIBUTION.INDIVIDUAL_LIMITS: Individual capacity for this inbox (blank uses the default)
DISTRIBUTION.TITLE: Distribution for this connection
DISTRIBUTION.GLOBAL_FALLBACK: No connection-specific rule has been saved. Existing account-wide distribution rules remain applicable. Save an explicitly disabled rule to disable automatic distribution for this connection.
DISTRIBUTION.HELP: Configure queues without reconnecting WhatsApp. Changes apply to new requests; assigned conversations keep their owner and reply channel. Availability, capacity and fallback follow the saved options.
DISTRIBUTION.DIRECT_HELP: Select exactly one queue. The conversation enters that queue without automatically assigning an agent.
DISTRIBUTION.PRIORITY_HELP: Arrange queues from highest to lowest priority using the move controls.
DISTRIBUTION.VALIDATION: Select an authorized queue to enable distribution, exactly one for direct mode, and a whole-number capacity from 1 to 100. Remove unavailable queues explicitly before saving.
DISTRIBUTION.SAVED: Distribution saved. Existing assigned conversations have been preserved.
DISTRIBUTION.LOAD_ERROR: Distribution could not be loaded. Reload to try again.
DISTRIBUTION.SAVE_ERROR: The update could not be confirmed. Reload the saved rule before trying again.
DISTRIBUTION.DENIED: Your access no longer permits viewing or changing this connection's distribution.
DISTRIBUTION.GLOBAL_POLICY_SUMMARY: Account-wide rule for this connection: {state}; {selection}; maximum open conversations: {capacity}
DISTRIBUTION.GLOBAL_ACCOUNT_POLICY_SUMMARY: Account-wide distribution: {state}; selected inbox IDs: {inboxes}; maximum open conversations: {capacity}
DISTRIBUTION.GLOBAL_EXCLUDED: Not included in the global selection
DISTRIBUTION.HISTORY_HELP: Distribution changes, including the previous and saved rules. Load older events to continue the audit.
DISTRIBUTION.HISTORY_ERROR: Distribution history could not be loaded. Try again.
DISTRIBUTION.FALLBACK: Outside hours or no eligible agent
DISTRIBUTION.AWAITING_CONNECTION: You can save these rules. Incoming distribution is waiting for reconnection.

SHIFTS.TITLE: Individual weekly shifts
SHIFTS.HELP: Configure one agent at a time for this inbox. Times use {timezone} and must also respect the inbox calendar when enabled.
SHIFTS.NO_AGENTS: Add agents to this inbox before configuring shifts.
SHIFTS.ENABLED: Use an individual shift for this agent
SHIFTS.INHERITED: This agent inherits the configured inbox working hours. Manual pauses and capacity limits still apply.
SHIFTS.PERIOD_HELP: Add working periods around lunch. Days without a period start have no shift of their own. An end before the start finishes on the next day. Midnight as the end of a period starting at midnight means a full day.
SHIFTS.OFF: No period starts on this day. Overnight periods from the previous day may still apply.
SHIFTS.INVALID: Use valid, non-overlapping working periods. Each day allows up to four periods.
SHIFTS.OBSOLETE: Saved distribution settings for former inbox member {id}. Remove this shift and any obsolete capacity or supervisor settings before saving.

CONNECTIONS.TITLE: WhatsApp connections
CONNECTIONS.HELP: View your authorized WhatsApp connections and reconnect an existing number without changing its inbox.
CONNECTIONS.UNAVAILABLE: The connection state could not be checked. Its configuration has been preserved. Refresh to try again.
CONNECTIONS.NUMBER_UNAVAILABLE: Number not available in the connection response.
CONNECTIONS.SNAPSHOT_HELP: These states reflect the last check, not confirmation of message delivery. Opening a connection checks its current permissions and state again.

ASSIGNMENT.TITLE: Human service distribution
ASSIGNMENT.HELP: After the flow selects a team, assign to an online member of both that team and the original inbox, with the fewest open conversations across this account. If nobody is available, keep the conversation in the human queue. The reply number stays unchanged.
ASSIGNMENT.INBOXES: Apply only to these inboxes. Other inboxes keep their current assignment rules.
ASSIGNMENT.NO_INBOXES: Create an inbox before enabling distribution.
ASSIGNMENT.CAPACITY: Maximum open conversations per agent across all inboxes
ASSIGNMENT.ERROR: Could not load or save the settings. Refresh and try again.

JRC_BROKER.ADOPT_HELP: Link an existing Broker inbox without recreating it or changing its conversation history.
JRC_BROKER.CONNECTIONS_HELP: Check your inbox connection and scan its QR code without opening a conversation.
JRC_BROKER.NO_CONNECTIONS: No JRC WhatsApp inbox is available to you in this account. Ask an administrator to link your inbox and assign your access.
JRC_BROKER.AGENT_CONNECTIONS_HELP: Reconnection is available to authorized inbox members. An administrator approves the first connection and any change of business number.
JRC_BROKER.TITLE: WhatsApp — JRC Broker
JRC_BROKER.GRANTS_HELP: Allow selected inbox members to reconnect the approved business number. They cannot create a new connection, change the number or disconnect WhatsApp. Removing an agent from the inbox removes this permission.
JRC_BROKER.DESCRIPTION: Connect and manage your company's WhatsApp through JRC.
JRC_BROKER.DISABLED: JRC Broker is not enabled for this account.
JRC_BROKER.UNVERIFIED_HELP: An inbox or connected number alone does not confirm delivery. Both incoming and outgoing messages must be verified.
JRC_BROKER.EXPIRED: This code has expired. Request a new code when you are ready.

PAIR_PROGRESS.SUCCEEDED: The connection step finished without a reusable QR. Request a new code to continue.
PAIR_PROGRESS.FAILED: The connection attempt failed. Check the inbox status, then request a new code.
PAIR_PROGRESS.UNKNOWN: The result is uncertain. Check the connection state before another request and ask an administrator if it stays uncertain.

JRC_BROKER.IDENTITY_WARNING: Confirm that the WhatsApp number ending in {suffix} belongs to this inbox. A different number pauses delivery until an administrator approves it.
JRC_BROKER.DISCONNECT_WARNING: Disconnecting stops this inbox from sending and receiving WhatsApp messages until it is connected again.
JRC_BROKER.UNDERSTAND: I have checked the number and understand the effect on this inbox.
JRC_BROKER.CONFIG_HELP: An administrator must approve this Chatwoot account in the Broker and issue its limited control key. The key is stored encrypted on the server and is never shown to agents.
JRC_BROKER.CONFIGURED: Account configuration saved. The stored key cannot be displayed.
JRC_BROKER.RETRY_INTENT: Check and retry the same request
JRC_BROKER.UNCERTAIN: The response was interrupted. The request may have been accepted. Retry the same request or resume an operation below.
JRC_BROKER.CANCEL_SETUP: Cancel setup and keep created resources
JRC_BROKER.UNKNOWN_HELP: The result is uncertain. Check the existing inbox before attempting another creation.

ERROR.INVALID_SETUP: The setup request was rejected. Check your access and the connection details before trying again.
ERROR.DENIED: This action is no longer available. Ask your account administrator to check your access.
ERROR.CONFLICT: The previous connection attempt needs review. Check this inbox and ask an administrator to reconcile it before requesting another code.
ERROR.UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the Broker. The inbox and connection have been preserved. Try again shortly.
ERROR.CONFIGURATION: Could not validate this configuration. Check the approved account, origin and control key.

HISTORY.TITLE: Connection history
HISTORY.HELP: Recorded requests and observed session changes. Events before this history was enabled are not reconstructed.

EVENTS.DISTRIBUTION_ASSIGNED: Conversation assigned to an eligible agent

HISTORY_SYNC.TITLE: WhatsApp history and files
HISTORY_SYNC.ERROR: Unable to confirm progress for this inbox. Check the connection and your permissions.
HISTORY_SYNC.EMPTY: No synchronization has been admitted for this inbox.
HISTORY_SYNC.UNKNOWN_TOTAL: The WhatsApp total is not yet confirmed. These counts describe processed batches, not a percentage of the phone.
HISTORY_SYNC.PENDING: Some items need review. Retained records will be preserved.
HISTORY_SYNC.BACKGROUND: A verified file in the Broker still needs persistence confirmation in JRC. Synchronization does not depend on this panel remaining open.

WORKSPACE.HOW_HELP: Connect your WhatsApp and choose how new conversations reach the right teams.

STEPS.CONNECT: Connect a number securely using its QR code.
STEPS.QUEUES: Select the teams that will receive new conversations.
STEPS.RULES: Set availability, capacity and service hours.

WORKSPACE.METRICS_HELP: Measured from persisted conversation and reporting events. Resolution time includes waiting; it is not active handling time.
WORKSPACE.METRICS_RESTRICTED: Metrics are available to users with reporting access.
WORKSPACE.PAIR_HELP: On the original phone, open WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device and scan the code.
WORKSPACE.PAIR_STEP_1: Use the same business number already linked to this inbox.
WORKSPACE.PAIR_STEP_2: Keep your phone connected to the internet.
WORKSPACE.PAIR_STEP_3: Wait for the connection confirmation. Your queues and rules are preserved.
WORKSPACE.CONNECTED_SUCCESS: Connection confirmed. Your queues and rules were preserved.
WORKSPACE.SELECT_CONNECTION: Choose a connection to configure its distribution.
